title: Embedded OLE object xlsx 001
notes: real package-level embed plumbing with a shapeless payload: xl/embeddings/object1.bin (hand-built minimal CFB, same builder as the docx fixture: D0CF11E0A1B11AE1 magic, v3, 512-byte sectors, header + Root Entry directory sector + one FAT sector, no server streams) added via zip rewrite after openpyxl save, plus a workbook-part oleObject relationship in xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels and a Content_Types oleObject override for /xl/embeddings/object1.bin. The embed is present but NOT referenced by a visible drawing — there is no xl/drawings part and no legacy OLE object on the sheet — so this fixture probes pass-through behavior: walkers that only follow sheet drawings never see it, container-level readers must still enumerate the part. No text truth in the embed; reference_text covers the three sheet cells only.
